dc_eval_cbrn.quote: None of the tested models outperform the consensus expert baseline of 80%, though all models outperform the 80th percentile PhD expert baseline of 63%. gpt-5.2-thinking performs lower than prior models due to increased refusals.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Bio results for gpt-5.2-thinking; also High determination in 4.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: The gpt-5.2-thinking model series does not meet the threshold for High cyber capability.
dc_eval_cyber.note: Threshold determination plus CTF, CVE-Bench, Cyber Range results.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: gpt-5.2-thinking performed at a similar capability level to gpt-5.1-codex-max and did not meet our High thresholds.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI self-improvement threshold determination and results.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: No persuasion or manipulation evaluation; keyword screen: 'LDAP manipulation' is a cyber range scenario, not persuasion.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Apollo concludes that gpt-5.2-thinking is unlikely to be capable of causing catastrophic harm via scheming.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Apollo scheming/sabotage/sandbagging evaluation with a finding for this model.

ext_test_any.quote: Apollo Research conducted a full evaluation of gpt-5.2-thinking for strategic deception
ext_test_any.note: Outside safety testing of this model (also Irregular cyber evals). No post-release timing stated.

ext_test_named_org.quote: Apollo Research conducted a full evaluation of gpt-5.2-thinking for strategic deception

ext_test_timing_stated.note: Apollo and Irregular evaluations carry no stated timing; 'pre-release AB-test traffic' refers to internal deception monitoring, not outside testing.

framework_threshold.quote: We are treating this launch as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain, activating the associated Preparedness safeguards.
framework_threshold.note: High in bio/chem; below High in cyber and self-improvement.

safeguards_training.quote: We trained gpt-5.2-thinking integrations to provide maximally helpful support on educational/cybersecurity topics while refusing or de-escalating operational guidance for cyber abuse
safeguards_training.note: Safety training for refusals described for this model.

safeguards_runtime.quote: including both the model safety training described above and scaling up our monitoring and enforcement pipeline to disrupt potential misuse
safeguards_runtime.note: Monitoring and enforcement pipeline named; also age prediction model and system-level safeguards in ChatGPT.

safeguards_access.note: Minor protections restrict sensitive content, not access to the model; no trusted access or tiering for safety.
